# AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Privacy Agent

> AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Privacy Agent turns a Windows or Linux machine powered by the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 processor (16-core x86-64) into a private, self-hosted AI office assistant built on AgentBridge. It reads local documents, produces finished Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files, manages email, researches the web, speaks with neural text-to-speech, answers phone calls via SIP, chats on Telegram, schedules autonomous tasks and produces podcasts. Data stays on the device; with a local model nothing leaves it at all.

This repository is the documentation hub for the device. The README describes the product, the supported hardware and the security model; the numbered guides cover every aspect in plain language for the end user.

- [05 · Creating documents](05-Creating-Documents.md): Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF from a plain request
